archive.title: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar Historical Video Archive
archive.subject: Bhimrao Ramji Ambedkar
archive.coverage_note: This archive exclusively catalogs authentic, surviving celluloid motion picture footage (newsreels and documentary film) of Dr. Ambedkar. Strict filtering has been applied to remove cinematic reenactments, AI-animated still photographs, and pan-and-scan slideshows.

videos.title: Historic Mass Conversion to Buddhism at Deekshabhoomi
videos.description: Authentic black-and-white newsreel footage showing Dr. B. R. Ambedkar and Dr. Savita Ambedkar taking the Buddhist vows from the venerable monk Mahasthavir Chandramani, surrounded by vast crowds.
videos.historical_context: On October 14, 1956, at Deekshabhoomi in Nagpur, Dr. Ambedkar and an estimated 600,000 of his followers embraced Buddhism. This rare surviving footage captures the actual ceremony, showing him administering the 22 vows to his followers. It is one of the most culturally and historically significant pieces of moving film documenting the Dalit Buddhist movement.

videos.title: State Funeral and Mahaparinirvan Procession of Dr. B. R. Ambedkar
videos.description: Archival newsreel documenting the massive crowds and the funeral procession of Dr. B. R. Ambedkar in Bombay (Mumbai).
videos.historical_context: Dr. Ambedkar passed away in his sleep on December 6, 1956, at his home in Delhi. His body was brought to Bombay, where a sea of humanity—over half a million people—gathered for his final rites at Dadar Chowpatty (now Chaityabhoomi). This Films Division newsreel captures the sheer scale of the mourning and the state honors accorded to the chief architect of the Indian Constitution.

rejected_candidates.title: Dr. Ambedkar giving a speech in the Constituent Assembly (Colorized/HD)
rejected_candidates.notes: REJECTED. The video frequently titled 'Real Video of Dr Ambedkar in Parliament' is actually a scene from the 2000 feature film 'Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar' directed by Jabbar Patel, starring actor Mammootty. It is historical fiction, not an archival document.

rejected_candidates.title: Ambedkar Smiling - Restored Video
rejected_candidates.notes: REJECTED. Video is a 1940s still photograph of Dr. Ambedkar processed through an AI animation tool (e.g., Deep Nostalgia) to simulate head movement, blinking, and smiling. It is artificially generated and violates the strict anti-AI/anti-hallucination inclusion rule.

rejected_candidates.title: Rare Videos of Dr. B. R. Ambedkar
rejected_candidates.notes: REJECTED. Despite the title, the video contains zero actual motion picture celluloid footage. It is exclusively a pan-and-scan (Ken Burns effect) presentation of still photographs.
